Miami hotel prices: median $225 a night with taxes and fees, 17 hotels priced Sep 25, 2026

These prices were read on September 25, 2026 for a stay of Oct 30 to Nov 1, 2026, which has passed. Check today's price for your dates

Miami's median: $225 a night all-in, at 13 hotels for 2 adults, from $79 at Atrium Design District to $610 at Four Seasons Hotel Miami.

Check a Miami hotel for your dates or check any hotel's price

Google Hotels returned these 17 Miami hotels, on 55 booking sites; Miami's median was the 7th highest of the 25 cities priced that day. Listed prices only: Pullman Miami Airport, Sheraton Miami Airport Hotel & Executive Meeting Center, Hilton Miami Downtown and InterContinental Miami by IHG.

Our search was "hotels in Miami". By their names, 5 of the 17 are near Miami International Airport and 1 is in South Beach. So this is not a Miami Beach price. Airport of Miami: Miami International (MIA).

The booking sites at Miami hotels

55 sites, 10 of them at one hotel only. Most hotels listed: Hotels.com at 17 and Booking.com at 16. Fewest sites: Atrium Design District (6); most: Novotel Miami Brickell (28, as were 3 others).

Hotels.com was lowest at Sheraton Miami Airport Hotel & Executive Meeting Center of its 17, and 5%+ above another site at 15. Booking.com was lowest at Atrium Design District and Sheraton Miami Airport Hotel & Executive Meeting Center of its 16, and 5%+ above another site at 14. CheapTickets.com was lowest at Casa Agave Miami of its 12, and 5%+ above another site at 11.

The hotel's own site, at 12 of the 17: lowest at none, a median 38% above the lowest site. Nearest: JW Marriott Miami, $332 against $330 on Traveluro. Farthest: EVEN Hotel Miami - Airport by IHG, $211 against $105 on Super.com.

Lowest at 5%+ below the going rate: Super.com at 8, Vio.com at 3, Etrip.net at 2, goseek.com at 2, HotelTonight.com at 1, Pilot at 1 and Traveluro at 1 (ties count for each). All cities: which booking site was lowest most often.

Google's free cancellation label was on a site's lowest listing at 11 of the 17, on the lowest price at 3 (Casa Agave Miami, Sheraton Miami Airport Hotel & Executive Meeting Center and EAST Miami); at the other 8 it cost a median $15 (9%) more. Is it worth it?

A lower price may be a smaller room or a non-refundable rate. Up to 28 listings were kept per hotel.

Taxes and fees in Miami

They added a median of 13.0% ($28 a night) to the before-tax going rate. It ran from 11.9% at Mayfair House Hotel & Garden to 16.2% at Atrium Design District; our data does not split taxes from fees. The 4 listed prices may leave out resort or property fees. More: hotel booking fees explained.

Miami, priced again a week later

Same stay, same Miami hotels, 7 days apart, before tax; up and down mean more than 2%. Each stay links its CSV.

  • Oct 13 to Oct 15 stay, Sep 22 then Sep 29: 1 up, 4 down of 9; rose most Courtyard by Marriott Miami Airport, $120 to $128; fell most Embassy Suites by Hilton Miami International Airport, $155 to $130; another site lowest at 4.
  • Oct 30 to Nov 1 stay, Sep 25 then Oct 2: 10 up, 3 down of 17; rose most The New Yorker Miami Hotel, $120 to $157; fell most JW Marriott Miami, $370 to $294; another site lowest at 13.

One week is no rule for when to book.

Questions about Miami hotel prices

How much is a hotel in Miami?

$225 a night all-in at the median (Sep 25, 2026 prices), from $79 at Atrium Design District to $610 at Four Seasons Hotel Miami.

Does our data show the cheapest time to book a hotel in Miami?

No: these prices come from a few Miami dates, not a season. Sep 25 to Oct 2: 10 Miami hotels rose more than 2%, 3 fell; The New Yorker Miami Hotel rose most, $120 to $157 before tax.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Miami hotels?

Below the going rate, most often Super.com (8 hotels) and Vio.com (3 hotels). The hotel's own site: lowest at none of 12.

How we measured this

The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price). The study's method. Words last changed November 23, 2026; prices read September 25, 2026; each hotel's page has every site's price in the newest snapshot that priced it.

Nearest medians to Miami's: Cancun $233, Las Vegas $196, New York $191, Chicago $276.
